rows.Benefits Description.Covered medications: ACE Inhibitors/Beta Blockers (blood pressure medication) - Network Retail Pharmacy Benefit applies to certain generic oral medications. Notes: • For preferred or non-preferred medications, please see regular Plan benefits. • This benefit is not available at non-network retail pharmacies or CVS Caremark Mail Service.

rows.Benefits Description.Covered medications: Preferred Insulin - Network Retail Pharmacy All coinsurances are for up to a 30-day supply per prescription. Copay maximums increase for fills greater than a 30-day supply. Notes: • For generic or non-preferred medications, please see regular Plan benefits. • If you or your physician chooses a brand name medication when a generic is available, you will be charged the generic copay plus the difference in cost between the brand name and the generic. • This benefit is not available at non-network retail pharmacies.

rows.Benefits Description.Covered medications: Non-Network Retail Pharmacy All copayments/coinsurance are for up to a 30-day supply per prescription. Copay maximums increase for fills greater than a 30-day supply. Notes: • If a participating pharmacy is not available where you reside or you do not use your identification card, you may submit your claim, with original drug receipts. • Reimbursement will be based on G.E.H.A's costs had you used a participating pharmacy. You pay the difference between our allowance and the cost of the drug. - Submit your prescription reimbursement request to: • CVS Caremark, PO Box 52136, Phoenix, AZ 85072-2136; • Online via Caremark web portal (geha.com/Prescriptions- Summary); or Caremark mobile app (available for Android and Apple). - You must submit original drug receipts.
